The genuinely useful features are the sentiment-lexicon counts (positive/negative keyword counts), plus helpfulness_ratio and review_year. Because the strongest predictive leverage rests on a couple of crude lexicon counts while the rest is mechanical, the set provides moderate but not strong incremental predictive power beyond the original columns."
